name: 0.20mm Non-planar top @MINIIS
description: 0.20mm Standard for Prusa MINI/MINI+ with input shaping with curved top shells; the shell count (2 to 6), pattern and ironing are chosen for each curved area. Thin curved parts (up to 3 mm) print in curved layers throughout on meshes with holes; closed meshes keep planar interiors. Uses the shared prusa-mini head.
